name: Amphibious
description:
You are agile in water but are weak when away from it.

Your base Speed is doubled while swimming, and you can breathe in both air and water.

You must immerse yourself in a body of water larger than yourself for at least 1 hour each day or become Weary. This state persists - regardless of your Endurance scores - until you immerse yourself for 1 hour.

Describe the effects of this need and how you sate it.
